question: Four letter clusters pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner, while one is different. Select the odd letter cluster pair.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc629db0e68bf6474a41d2818dafbe2717029f29d84abd8a7ef21934b26824bd.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1ea47c55d330b263bd3a82bd7fb29f4f08d6d8802baeee752a4abed9556df11.png] 

All follow the same pattern except “KI - TQ” 

Hence, “KI - TQ” is odd among them.
